scoring.formula: 5R + 2H + 2I + N - 3G; rank within bands, never as a probability
scoring.R: proof relevance: 3 potential full pointwise conclusion, 2 frontier-changing partial theorem, 1 ordinary partial theorem, 0 no ES implication
scoring.H: plausibility 0–3 of the clean theorem with current/foreseeable tools, not inherited from source
scoring.I: one-day information gain: 0 slogan/no discriminating test, 1 bounded diagnostic, 2 clear falsifier or first lemma
scoring.N: new mechanism relative to FRONTIER: 0 existing, 1 variant/audit repair, 2 genuinely distinct
scoring.G: unsupported bridge burden: 0 direct algebra/known theorem, 1 one difficult named step, 2 several gaps, 3 object/mechanism not defined or global bridge absent
scoring.caveat: Ordinal expected-proof-value proxy, not calibrated success odds; bands separate proof components from side work and rest. High relevance does not mean a viable proof.
